title: RAID EVENTS: ORBITAL DEBRIS
why: His answer to give me the events: all six raid events, one or two per raid, each with a map marker and a countdown ring. This build is the event system and the first event. A raid now plans one or two events from its seed (so a party on the same seed meets the same ones), the first about two and a half to three and a half minutes in. An event shows a ring on the ground that fills round as the countdown runs down, with its name and the seconds, and a marker with the time on the minimap and the sector map. ORBITAL DEBRIS: a 22 second warning over a wide ring, then five pieces fall inside it, each shown by a shadow and a dashed ring for two seconds before it lands. A piece hurts everything it lands on, you included, and leaves a burning wreck: a fire you cannot walk through for 45 seconds with a wreck on its edge holding two good items, marked on the map until you open it. The other five events come in the next builds. DEMO and CAREER work the same.
now: Raids now plan one or two events with a countdown ring and a map mark; the first is orbital debris with burning loot wrecks.
